question: Which of the following banks features in the Fortune Global 500 list 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**State Bank of India**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Fortune Global 500 list is Published by** Fortune magazine**.
 
• **Walmart has topped the list**** **__in terms of revenue for the** Eighth consecutive year and the 16th time since 1995**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Fortune Global list is prepared on the basis of **total revenue made by the companies**.
 
• **Seven Indian companies** made it to the 500 lists.
 
• **Mukesh Ambani-led Reliance Industries Ltd** is the **highest-ranked Indian company** on the list in terms of revenue, with revenues of nearly **$63 billion.**
